headline: Approved $2,400.00 ABL Tech invoice, $4,000.00 and $360.00 Segal invoices, and four retirement requests.
summary: The meeting included a July preliminary and June quarterly performance report from DAHAB Associates. Members approved the June minutes, three invoices, and four normal retirement requests.
decisions: Approved the regular June meeting minutes, passed unanimously.
Approved the $2,400.00 invoice from ABL Tech for MVerify annual fee, passed unanimously.
Approved the $360.00 invoice from Segal for benefit and surviving spouse calculations, passed unanimously.
Approved the $4,000.00 invoice from Segal for retiree COLA statements and mailing, passed unanimously.
Approved normal retirement of Jeremy Brewer as of July 24, 2026, passed unanimously.
Approved normal retirement of Douglas O'Rourke as of July 5, 2026, passed unanimously.
Approved normal retirement of Paul Calamita as of August 22, 2026, passed unanimously.
Approved normal retirement of Kevin Samperi effective June 23, 2026, passed unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: Regular June meeting minutes. Chairman Sendroff Motioned to approve the minutes. Board member Mckeon seconded the motion. Motion passes unanimously.

Invoice from ABL Tech in the total amount of $2,400.00 for MVerify Services Annual Fee: 7.10.2026 to 7.9.2027. Board member Bob Freeman motioned to approve the invoice . Board member Henry Dove seconded the motion. Motion passes unanimously.

Invoice from Segal in the amount of $360.00 for the calculations of one (1) benefit calculation and two (2) surviving spouse calculations. Board member Bob Freeman motioned to approve the invoice. Board member Henry Dove seconded the motion. Motion passes unanimously.

Invoice from Segal in the total amount of $4,000.00 for the calculations of retiree COLA statements and mailing. Board member Henry Dove motioned to approve the invoice. Board member Bob Freeman seconded the motion. Motion passes unanimously.

Jeremy Brewer, a former Hamden vested police Officer, is requesting normal retirement as of July 24, 2026. Chairperson Sendroff motioned to approve the retirement request. Board member Bob Freeman seconded the motion. Motion passes unanimously.

Douglas O'Rourke, Leiutenant of the Hamden Fire Department, would like to request a normal retirement as of July 5, 2026. Chairperson Adam Sendroff motioned to approve the retirement request. Board member Bob Freeman seconded the motion. Motion passes unanimously.

Paul Calamita, Sergeant of the Hamden Police Department, would like to request a normal retirement as of August 22, 2026. Chairperson Adam Sendroff motions to approve the retirement request. Board member Bob Freeman seconded the motion. The motion passed unanimously.

Kevin Samperi, Deputy Chief with the Hamden Police Department, would like to request a normal retirement effective June 23rd, 2026. Chairperson Adam Sendroff motions to approve the retirement request. Board member Bob Freeman seconded the motion. The motion passed unanimously.

$4,000.00 Segal invoice for retiree COLA statements
plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
Retirement Board Minutes         
         
Regular Meeting 
 
3:00 PM, August 12, 2026 
  
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 Click to View Agenda   
  
1. CALL TO ORDER   
 3:00 pm 
2. ATTENDANCE   
 Board Members: Chairperson, Mayor Adam Sendroff, Myron Hul, Joe Colello, Leiutenant 
Timothy McKeon, Chris Rhone, Henry Dove and Bob Freeman. 
Human Resources Representatives: Jordanne Bryan, Ken Kelley, Susy Diaz-Callands. 
Dahab Representative:Tom Donegan. 
Public Members:  
3. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES   
 
 
  1. Regular June  meeting minutes.   
  Chairman Sendroff Motioned to approve the minutes. 
Board member Mckeon seconded the motion. 
Motion passes unanimously. 
4. PUBLIC COMMENT   
 None.  
5. FINANCIAL   
 
 
 1. Presentation from DAHAB Associates July preliminary and June quarterly performance 
report. 
       
  June's quarterly and July's preliminary performance reports were presented by Dahab 
representative, Tom Donegan.  
6. ADMINISTRATIVE   
 
 
 1. Invoice from ABL Tech in the total amount of $2,400.00 for MVerify Services Annual 
Fee: 7.10.2026 to 7.9.2027. 
       
  Board member Bob Freeman motioned to approve the invoice . 
Board member Henry Dove seconded the motion. 
Motion passes unanimously.
2. Invoice from Segal in the amount of $360.00 for the calculations of one (1) benefit 
calculation and two (2) surviving spouse calculations.  
       
  Board member Bob Freeman motioned to approve the invoice. 
Board member Henry Dove seconded the motion. 
Motion passes unanimously. 
 3. Invoice from Segal in the total amount of $4,000.00 for the calculations of retiree 
COLA statements and mailing.  
       
  Board member Henry Dove motioned to approve the invoice. 
Board member Bob Freeman seconded the motion. 
Motion passes unanimously. 
7. RETIREMEMENTS   
 
 
 1. Jeremy Brewer, a former Hamden vested police Officer, is requesting normal 
retirement as of July 24, 2026. 
       
  Chairperson Sendroff motioned to approve the retirement request. 
Board member Bob Freeman seconded the motion. 
Motion passes unanimously. 
 2. Douglas O'Rourke, Leiutenant of the Hamden Fire Department, would like to request a 
normal retirement as of July 5, 2026. 
       
  Chairperson Adam Sendroff motioned to approve the retirement request. 
Board member Bob Freeman seconded the motion. 
Motion passes unanimously. 
 3. Paul Calamita, Sergeant of the Hamden Police Department, would like to request a 
normal retirement as of August 22, 2026.  
       
  
• Chairperson Adam Sendroff motions to approve the retirement request. 
• Board member Bob Freeman seconded the motion. 
• The motion passed unanimously. 
 
 4. Kevin Samperi, Deputy Chief with the Hamden Police Department, would like to 
request a normal retirement effective June 23rd, 2026. 
       
  
• Chairperson Adam Sendroff motions to approve the retirement request. 
• Board member Bob Freeman seconded the motion. 
• The motion passed unanimously. 
 
8. CORRESPONDENCE   
 None. 
9. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney)  
 None. 
10. OLD BUSINESS
None. 
11. NEW BUSINESS   
 
 
  1. Correspondence from Brett Ferrara, appointing a Police Department representative 
to the HERB board. The new representative will be Lieutenant Timothy Mckeon.  
  A formal memo to the board was received from Brett Ferrara to inform Tim McKeon 
will be taking his place as a new board member. 
 
  
12. ADJOURNMENT   
 3:52 pm
